settings.heading: Shipping & delivery
settings.intro: Every Sploot piece is printed to order, then sent on its way with a tracked carrier. Here's exactly what to expect — production, transit, and what happens if anything goes sideways.
settings.step1_body: Each piece is printed for you after you order. 98% of orders are produced within 48 hours.
settings.step2_body: Your order ships with a tracked carrier. A tracking number is emailed and synced to your account.
settings.step3_body: It lands. Delivery is confirmed once the carrier marks the package Delivered.
settings.table_note: Windows are carrier transit time in business days, added on top of ~2 days production. Shipping cost is calculated at checkout based on your cart size and destination. Remote areas may run longer.

settings.question: Everything is made to order
settings.answer: We don't hold stock — each garment is printed when you order it. That keeps the catalog wide and waste low, but it means the clock starts at production (~2 business days), then carrier transit on top.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: A tracking number is emailed to you and synced to your account the moment your order ships. You can follow it in real time at 17track.net.

settings.question: I entered the wrong address
settings.answer: Email us right away. If the order hasn't gone into production we can update it. Once it ships to a wrong or incomplete address, any storage, handling, and redelivery costs are the customer's responsibility.

settings.question: My order is running late
settings.answer: Every order is backed by a Delay Compensation Guarantee. If a package runs significantly past its estimate, contact us — depending on the case we'll make it right with compensation, a reshipment, or a full refund.

settings.question: My item arrived damaged or wrong
settings.answer: That's on us. Email jcsimon2030@gmail.com within 14 days of delivery with photos of the item and packaging and we'll replace it or refund you.

settings.question: Customs, duties & import taxes
settings.answer: International orders may incur duties or import taxes set by the destination country. These are the customer's responsibility and are not included in the order total.
